
The book ''Parsing Techniques - A Practical Guide'' is available on the web in Postscript and PDF format at: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110402024640/http://www.cs.vu.nl:80/~dick/PTAPG.html http://www.cs.vu.nl:80/~dick/PTAPG.html]

It contains nearly everything you could possibly want to know about machine parsing techniques. Also it contains a <u>HUGE</u> annotated bibliography covering every important paper in the field of parsing written up until its publication.
